0.name: Values Log
0.description:
You can challenge a Value Statement (act against your own Value) when you have the spotlight:

  • Roll three dice for that Value instead of one
  • Step the Value down

At the end of the session either rewrite the Value Statement and recover the dice, or keep the new Value dice and:

  • Step up another Value.
  • Record the act you took against the Value you just stepped up in the Value Log.

If you step up a Value beyond a D12 you must read to the table the Value Log.  The other players will then vote regarding how you transcend that Value.

0.label: The Way of the Possum is more powerful than Damo.
Background
0.value:
• You left a Tradition chantry in the Blue Mountains together - stuffy, academic, going nowhere - to find your own way to Ascension in Sydney.

  • You've settled into meeting regularly at the Kythera Milk Bar on Anzac Parade, La Perouse - Steve and Despina's place with Col holding court at the counter.

  • You heard at the chantry that a Node is convergence of power that can be drawn upon and used to protect against paradox. You know there was a Node at the chantry but it was jealously guarded and you never were able to see or use it.

  • You have a glossy Earth Current Fellowship brochure promising ley-line enlightenment. You've heard they've levitated a member in public at Balmoral Beach.

  • At the chantry you were told of an Ashkaric Brother, Arthur Pell, who walked out in 1951 (long before you arrived). He runs a free tai chi class in Sydney and is said to know the lines better than anyone. You were warned though that most people give him a wide berth, considering him a little unstable.

1.label: Suggested Changes
1.value:
Mark: A lot of the world is image, but you are going to have to take part in it regardless.

A mark should be closer to a negative event that has scarred you in some way. Suggestion:

  • Never admit your failings: Lost my first big shot by admitting I was faking. Never again.

Restraint: You must usually submit to teaching in order to learn

Recommend removing the word 'usually':

  • You must submit to teaching in order to learn.

Reason: A lot of our world is image, you want to be fairly skeptical

Challenging this may conflict with your core beliefs that do not change:

  • A lot of the world is image, the reality concealed could be almost anything.

  • A lot of the world is image, but you are going to have to take part in it regardless.

What about changing Paradigm to:

  • Style over substance - always.

and then changing Reason to:

  • I should always fake it and lie to get ahead, and assume eveyrone else does the same.

Signature Assets

Starting signature assets may only have the SFX "Spend a Point Point to step up <SKILL/POWER>"

Pick a skill for "Shrine of the Masters" - because only one can be a power (it is both skills, or 1 skill + 1 power).

0.label: Laws of Magick
0.value:
1. A player's ability to solve conflict with magick is DIRECTLY PROPORTIONAL to how well the other players understand said magick.
  2. Limitations are more important than powers.
  3. Expand what you already have before you add something new.

1.label: Narration
1.value:
• TEST: When the player succeeds they full narrate the outcome; success die sets the scale of the outcome.  When the player fails the GM narrates the outcome; effect die sets the size of any complication inflicted on the player.
  • CONTEST: as-per TEST except if a player "gives in".  If a player gives in they get a plot point and may narrate how they lost.  The GM selects the resulting complication.
  • HITCHES: The GM assigns the complication, but the player narrates their own mistake.
  • TAKEN-OUT / BOTCH: The GM narrates the outcome.

Rules:

  1. You can't contradict the dice. Narration explains the mechanical result; it doesn't renegotiate it.
  2. The GM is the final arbiter and can amend or veto narration that overreaches.

0.label: Limit - Blood Price
0.value:
Decline Paradox stress ≤ your rolled Power die but do not shut down the set. The declined backlash demands a sacrifice. Take a physical Blood Loss complication one step larger than the Paradox avoided.

Recovery: in addition to the usual ways of clearing a complication, the Blood Loss complication can be transferred to another person by drawing their blood in a ritual lasting several hours.

1.label: SFX - The Red Sign
1.value: Add a physical complication d6 to yourself or a willing ally. If you do, step up a Verbena Power trait for the rest of the scene.

2.label: SFX - Blood Tells
2.value: When you would take Paradox stress ≤ your rolled Power die, you may spend a plot point to channel it into a living creature whose blood you have ritually spilled this scene, destroying the creature. The sacrifice can absorb a complication no larger than the life it holds: a small animal takes no more than a d6, a large animal a d8, a human life a d10. Greater backlash demands a greater death.

Background
0.value:
• You left a Tradition chantry in the Blue Mountains together - stuffy, academic, going nowhere - to find your own way to Ascension in Sydney.

  • You've settled into meeting regularly at the Kythera Milk Bar on Anzac Parade, La Perouse - Steve and Despina's place with Col holding court at the counter.

  • Frenchmans Beach and Congwong bay are near, but not great for surfing. Maroubra is a little further away but provides great surf on the east coast.

  • You're always looking for some cash-in-hand jobs; you've pulled these two out of the local paper - carrying survey poles for a crew at La Perouse, and counting possums out at Little Bay.

  • A few times while surfing lately you've "zoned out" and found yourself pulled out to sea - but there's no rip, no current, nothing you can point to that explains it.

  • The regulars on the surf break often chat when the winds are calm; you've heard some rumours: some mornings there is a strange green glow in the sky above Cape Banks, and a large shark is stalking the outer reef.

1.label: Suggested Changes
1.value:

Suggest adjusting to limit scope to authority figures; otherwise this may conflict with Duty 'Use em and ditch em... They notice this eventually':

The World: Nothing changes. The world won't let it.

Suggest adjusting to be more nihilistic so it is more obvious how to challenge:

  • Nothing in the world changes, the world won't let it, so fuck it I'm not responsible.

Gnosis: Perfect harmony is total freedom.

Challenging this may conflict with the paradigm 'Perfect harmony and enlightment can be had if just all the bullshit fucked off.' Maybe adjust this so that it points more inwards:

0.description:
You can challenge a Value Statement (act against your own Value) when you have the spotlight:

  • Roll three dice for that Value instead of one
  • Step the Value down

At the end of the session either rewrite the Value Statement and recover the dice, or keep the new Value dice and:

  • Step up another Value.
  • Record the act you took against the Value you just stepped up in the Value Log.

If you step up a Value beyond a D12 you must read to the table the Value Log.  The other players will then vote regarding how you transcend that Value.

Record key events from a session, one session per section.

  • Callback: reference a previously recorded session during play as you act as an in-character nod to the past.  Gain a benfit equal to anything a Plot Point could bye (byt do not gain a Plot Point).  Each past session can only be called back once per session.
  • Training Up: Spend recorded sessions to make improvements to your character.  Once a session has been used for training up it can no longer be used as a Callback.

0.label: 20261006 - Session #1: Beat up and robbed Terry Vickers at Little Bay Scrub following possum count.
Adventure 1 - Little Bay Scrub Dr Tully, the possum scientist; Terry Vickers beaten in carpark ($250 stolen); Tawny Frog Mouth summoned; Ley Line out to sea discovered
Background
0.value:
• You left a Tradition chantry in the Blue Mountains together - stuffy, academic, going nowhere - to find your own way to Ascension in Sydney.

  • You've settled into meeting regularly at the Kythera Milk Bar on Anzac Parade, La Perouse - Steve and Despina's place with Col holding court at the counter.

  • The La Perouse Aboriginal community is one of Sydney's oldest.

  • Aunty Bettie, a well respected elder, is really worried about development that could destroy what's left of the bushland and the old meeting places sacred to the Koori people.

  • The songs have felt more real to you recently - though you couldn't say why.

  • Busking with your didgeridoo at Circular Quay one evening, a stranger sang back words from the very story you were playing - words no outsider should ever have known. He was an old white man, in his seventies, and spoke fluent Darug - better than you, maybe as good as Aunty Bettie. You were so surprised you didn't know what to do, and then he was gone.

0.label: Laws of Magick
0.value:
1. A player's ability to solve conflict with magick is DIRECTLY PROPORTIONAL to how well the other players understand said magick.
  2. Limitations are more important than powers.
  3. Expand what you already have before you add something new.

1.label: Narration
1.value:
• TEST: When the player succeeds they full narrate the outcome; success die sets the scale of the outcome.  When the player fails the GM narrates the outcome; effect die sets the size of any complication inflicted on the player.
  • CONTEST: as-per TEST except if a player "gives in".  If a player gives in they get a plot point and may narrate how they lost.  The GM selects the resulting complication.
  • HITCHES: The GM assigns the complication, but the player narrates their own mistake.
  • TAKEN-OUT / BOTCH: The GM narrates the outcome.

Rules:

  1. You can't contradict the dice. Narration explains the mechanical result; it doesn't renegotiate it.
  2. The GM is the final arbiter and can amend or veto narration that overreaches.

5.name: Limit & SFX
5.description: Reality is a negotiation. Every object, storm, and location has an awake, aware spirit. Magick is the act of stepping sideways, bargaining with, or commanding these entities.

0.label: Limit - Spirit Debt
0.value:
Decline Paradox stress ≤ your rolled Power die but do not shut down the set. Instead, the rejected Paradox angers the local spirits. Create an Offended Spirits Paradox Flaw complication one step larger than the Paradox avoided.

Recovery: in addition to the usual ways of clearing a Paradox Flaw, the Offended Spirits Paradox Flaw also resolves when you renew your standing with the spirits by means of an offering, a rite, or a kept pact.

1.label: SFX - Shaman's Bargain
1.value: Step up a Dreamspeaker Power trait for the rest of the scene when you make a promise and an offering to the spirits. The offering can be a physical sacrifice, burned tobacco or incense, or your own spilled blood. If you break a pact you have sworn to a spirit, you lose this benefit and the GM may immediately inflict a Spirit’s Rebuke d6 complication on you.

2.label: SFX - Counsel of Spirits
2.value: Spend a plot point to consult a local spirit, giving yourself or an ally a d8 Asset for a single test, contest, or challenge.

Decline Paradox stress ≤ your rolled Power die: take a plot point, shut down the set.

Recovery: recovers when you regain your centre at a scene of meditation.

1.label: SFX - Perfected Kata
1.value: Step up an Akashic Power trait when engaging in continuous, uninterrupted motion or meditation. This lasts until you choose to end Perfected Kata or until the end of the scene, whichever comes first. If you take a complication that breaks your physical stance or concentration, lose this benefit and additionally step down the selected Power trait until you recover the complication.

2.label: SFX - Still Mind
2.value: When you roll a Hitch while acting from perfect focus, spend a plot point to reroll your dice pool and keep the new result (this cannot rescue a vulgar botch).

4.description: To the Akashics, magick is the perfection of the self. The universe is an illusion; by mastering their own physical and mental discipline (Do), they force the universe to align with their internal harmony.
